name: trippin-the-chat-fantastic
description: Brainstorms 13 wild, impossible ideas in an "open the portal" state, then returns to sober analysis and picks the two that could actually work.

defaultPrompt: How can we roll back climate change?
How might we enable world peace?
What are the best ways to teach children to be responsible, curious adults?
interface.shortDescription: Wild brainstorm, then two ideas that could work
interface.longDescription: Brainstorms 13 wild, impossible ideas in an "open the portal" state, then returns to sober analysis and picks the two that could actually work. Ask a question, get a sober answer, then say "open the portal."
